goal: Provide accessible reusable logistics navigation, scope, attention, readiness, source-health, loading, empty, and error UI patterns.
working_set: components/admin/logistics/command-center/** (read-only for this lane: the admin lane owns the path; the design-system grant does not include components/admin/**)
acceptance_criteria: Reusable readiness pattern with explicit state, a bounded percentage, and a stated blocker reason. [MET - LogisticsReadinessIndicator; asserted by the pattern test: accessible name 'Readiness: Blocked', 140% clamped to 100%, reason text rendered, role=progressbar with aria-valuenow=100]

Reusable source-health pattern that keeps degraded and unavailable sources visible with their warnings rather than hiding them. [MET - LogisticsSourceHealthIndicator / LogisticsSourceHealthSummary; asserted: role=region 'Data source health' counting '2 sources need attention', per-source accessible labels for Degraded and Unavailable, warning text rendered]

Summary pattern that never renders an unavailable metric as a healthy zero. [MET - LogisticsSummaryStat; asserted: data-availability=unavailable, 'Unavailable' text present, the digit 0 absent from the card]

Reusable attention pattern with severity, domain, owner state, due time, freshness, reason, and an action affordance. [MET - LogisticsAttentionRow; asserted: role=article named by the title, severity/domain/'Unassigned'/due text present, the action link href is the real href]

Reusable loading, empty, and error patterns with correct semantics and a retry affordance. [MET - LogisticsCommandCenterLoading (role=status, aria-busy=true), LogisticsCommandCenterEmpty (role=region named by the title, action slot), LogisticsCommandCenterError (role=alert, 'Try again' invokes onRetry once)]
A summary panel that composes the set for the logistics Overview. [MET - LogisticsOverviewPanel, exported from the command-center barrel]

Reusable NAVIGATION pattern. [NOT MET - no navigation primitive exists in components/admin/logistics/command-center/; the barrel exports attention, error, empty, loading, readiness, source-health, summary-stat, types and the overview panel, and nothing navigation-shaped. Creating it requires components/admin/**, which the admin lane owns and the design-system grant excludes in this wave]

Reusable SCOPE pattern. [NOT MET - components/admin/logistics/logistics-scope-bar.tsx exists but sits one level ABOVE the command-center set, is a one-off admin-lane file, and is currently modified in the worktree by the admin lane. It is not exported from the barrel and is not covered by the pattern test]
Authenticated 200% zoom and show-day mobile review. [NOT MET and NOT THIS LANE'S TO CLOSE - owned by QA-007; the design-system lane holds no hosted session and claims no browser evidence]

WAVE 34 (2026-09-25): the reusable set is 8 source files - attention-row.tsx, error-state.tsx, states.tsx (loading + empty), status-indicators.tsx (readiness + source health), summary-stat.tsx, types.ts, logistics-overview-panel.tsx, and the index.ts barrel.
